title: Kessler Owner Rewards Member Rates on Vehicle Purchase Agreements Extension Deposits
content:
Kessler Owner Rewards members who hold a vehicle under the Vehicle Purchase Agreements pay an extension deposit rate set by their Owner Rewards standing. The standing is read from the buyer's service account in **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**: the account's tier and its status.

**Member rate clause.**
- A buyer whose service account is **Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum in active status** pays an extension deposit rate of **3 percent**.
- A buyer whose service account is **Kessler Owner Rewards Gold in active status** pays an extension deposit rate of **4 percent**.
- Every other buyer has no Owner Rewards member rate.

| Service account tier | Account status | Owner Rewards extension deposit rate |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | active | 3 percent |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | active | 4 percent |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum or Gold | closed | No member rate |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver, Service Guest Account, or a commercial fleet account | any | No member rate |
| No service account | n/a | No member rate |

**Reading the records.** The tier is the tier name shown on the buyer's service account, and the status is that account's current status. A member rate is earned only when both match one of the first two rows.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- A buyer whose service account shows Kessler Owner Rewards Gold, active: the rate is 4 percent.
- A buyer whose Platinum account shows closed: the account is not active, so no member rate applies.
- A buyer with a Kessler Owner Rewards Silver account, active: Silver carries no member rate, so none applies.
